Everyday Kit.name: Everyday Kit
Everyday Kit.description:
🍙 You carry ordinary comforts for daily life.

⚖️ All of it is legal and unremarkable.
👕 Casual clothes let you leave a uniform or costume behind and blend into a crowd.
🔄 Food and medicine are used up on use and restocked at any convenience store or pharmacy.

🎒 Starts with: Casual clothes, Bento box ×2, Painkillers, Bandages ×2, Omamori charm
Everyday Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has a set of everyday clothes for off-duty hours, boxed lunches, over-the-counter pain tablets, some bandage and tape, and a shrine charm for safety tied to their bag. All of it is legal and unremarkable. Casual clothes let them leave a uniform or costume behind and blend into a crowd, which matters to anyone who wants a private life apart from school, work or a hero identity. Food and medicine are used up on use and restocked at any convenience store or pharmacy.
